text: From F03.3 (1c38d22): GET /v1/datasets/{d}/grants and GET /v1/datasets/{d}/access?principal&permission[&release] exist (ManageAccess / self). Still F05.3: the grant API (Action enum) cannot issue Discover or ReadEvidence, so sharedScopes lists nothing for HTTP-issued grants; collaborator suggestions must use explain's known-on-dataset rule; ManageAccess holders can currently tell a disabled principal (404 on grant) from an unknown id (auto-created, 201).
